items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Then I went over to Tiny Grimes, who's an evil man if there ever was one, an evil man.

ctx.x: through. Now McShann gets out of the Army. Naturally, and I've got to go six months before I can work with out of town musicians. So Barry Ulanov and several of them come over there almost threatening me, you know, said, 'Look, you got to go back with McShann. He needs you, and you need him because you cannot make it in New York.'

So I told them, I said, 'Well, look, man, I am trying to get my #802 card, and I can't play with McShann because he's an out of town musician.' So I explained to McShann. He understood. And then I got situated then, and I went on in to working with Ben Webster steady. Then I went over to Tiny Grimes, who's an evil man if there ever was one, an evil man.
